page.layout: One printed page: a full-page engraved portrait of a man in a tricorn hat, wig and court dress with a star order, standing beside a draped table with an open book, a crown, a vase and curtains. At the right edge, a narrow strip of printed title text in red and black, running down the edge of the plate, partly cut off.
page.notes: The page is an engraved frontispiece portrait, not a text page. The printed title words at the right edge are cut off by the edge of the plate and are too fragmentary to read: the red lines appear to read something like "...CH..." and "...TH...", with a small line of italic text below ("...ph...", "...ther...") and "EL..." near the bottom. Those fragments are not legible enough to transcribe with any confidence. The engraving itself shows a standing man in a tricorn, wig and embroidered coat with a star badge, one hand on a book-laden table, a crown on a cushion at left, a potted plant in a vase at upper left, and a dog at lower right. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is visible.
